verdicts.claim: On sm_120 attention runs on FlashAttention 2
verdicts.correction: Not with the recommended --kv-cache-dtype fp8. FlashAttentionBackend.supports_combination rejects quantized KV unless FA3 on SM90 or FA4 ('FP8 KV cache requires FA3 on SM90, FA4 with head_size=512 on SM90, or FA4 on SM100'), and the non-SM100 priority list in platforms/cuda.py is FLASH_ATTN, FLASHINFER, TRITON_ATTN, so vLLM falls to FlashInfer (supports cc 8.0-12.1 and fp8 KV). The #54331 logs for the sister Ornith-35B NVFP4 on sm_120 show 'decode_backend=xqa, kv_cache_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn'. FA2 applies only with BF16 KV. The v0.33.0 Dockerfile installs FlashInfer precompiled kernels for all architectures (line 948-952), so a large attention JIT is unlikely but unmeasured.

summary: The record's runtime claims mostly hold on this machine. I re-read every load-bearing value live on 2026-11-15 and got the same results: the HF API file sizes, the NVFP4 safetensors header breakdown (8.212 GiB total, 6.910 GiB for the language model only without MTP), config.json (8 full-attention layers, 4 KV heads, head_dim 256, 24 GDN layers), hf_quant_config, and the v0.33.0 sources (registry, parser aliases, the Marlin W4A16 path on sm_120). vLLM KV math: 32 KiB per token in BF16, a pool of about 6.49 GiB, about 212k tokens with BF16 KV, and 262,144 (capped) with FP8 KV. Corrections: (1) With the recommended --kv-cache-dtype fp8, attention on sm_120 does not run on FlashAttention 2. FA2 rejects quantized KV outside FA3/FA4, so vLLM falls back to FlashInfer; the sister model's logs show xqa decode. (2) Issue #54331 was not reproduced even with FP8 KV and the Ornith-35B NVFP4 checkpoint on sm_120 (v0.28.0), so the record's 'BF16-only' framing is out of date. (3) In llama.cpp, q8_0 KV costs 8.5 bits per value, which gives 4.25 GiB at 262k and about 14.4 GiB in total. Free VRAM is 15.81 GiB, not 16.1, so Q8_0 at 262k fits but is tight; Q6_K or a 131k context is safer. Gaps: no run of any kind, the real hybrid block or page overhead with prefix caching is unmeasured, the GGUF-embedded template was not re-read, it was not checked whether vLLM accepts 'reasoning' back as reasoning_content in history, and no #54331 data exists for v0.33.0. The best realistic config is the record's own vLLM command (NVFP4, --language-model-only, FP8 KV, 262144 or 131072), with --enforce-eager as the fallback; on llama.cpp, Q6_K with q8_0 KV at 262144.
